title: A one-step counterexample to the normalized Nash blowup conjecture
summary: We construct an explicit normal singular affine toric variety X of dimension five over an algebraically closed field of characteristic three such that the normalized Nash blowup of X already contains an open affine subset isomorphic to X. Combined with previously known examples, this yields one-step counterexamples in every dimension greater than or equal to five and every characteristic.
